lines.en: : Wait, Yuki? What are you doing here?
: What am I doing here?...
: What...are you doing here?...
: And what the fuck happened...to all of my shit?
: I...live here. With my rat son. And this is his rat father, Akira.
: Oh good. Another animal to co-parent. Just what I wanted.
: Hey...I know that guy...
: I know you too, Yuki. Would you like to explain what’s going on right now?
: Nnnnnnnnnnnope.
: Yup. Saw that coming.
: Mnh...the fuck happened to my rug?...
: She hasn’t done this before, has she?
: Never.
: Get the...fuck outta my...apartment......I’m trying to.....go...mnh......sleep....
: Yuki, do I need to call an ambulance?
: You ain’t...gotta call shit...
: What did you take?
: Fuckin...nothing...okay? Now...fuck off...
: Akira?
: Don’t look at me. I’ve been here the whole time.
: Yeah, but you know her way better than I do.
: I just need to know if this is going to be a “hold her shoulders while she vomits into the toilet” night or an “I should have bought that NARCAN” night.
: Probably the former if she’s still somewhat coherent right now. But you never know how this stuff will progress and-
: Just...let me fuckin’ die, okay?! Mnh! Mblmm...mmnh...
: If you’re going to die, can you please crawl into one of the pre-drawn outlines? I was just talking about this a few minutes ago.
: I wish I had something more to say than I did the last time I saw you like this.
: What’d.....last time......say?.....
: Unbelievable.
: Why don’t you go home, Akira?
: And let you deal with this on your own?
: What, you think I’ve never had to nurse a junkie back to health before? Come on.
: I’ll get her into bed and watch her for a few hours to make sure she’s okay. It’s clear you don’t want to see her like this, so just leave it to me.
: At least let me help you carry her back to her apartment.
: No need. I’ll just keep her here. I bought a second futon in case Rin ever wanted to stay over. I’ll just sleep in that.
: If Yuki wakes up in the middle of the night and wants to go back, she can. You really don’t have to worry about it.
: But-
: I’ve got this. Okay? You’ve already fulfilled your manly duties for the day by listening to what an old woman had to say about her daughter’s safety and how it relates to your penis.
: Okay?
: I just don’t get it...
: She was doing so well.
: It’s impossible to get it unless you’ve been there.
: We’re all addicted to something, Akira. I’m sure you’ve got your vice as well.
: Yeah.
: Are you really sure you’ll be okay?
: Hey, Yuki! Want to have a sleepover? Stay silent for yes!
: See? She’s totally excited.
: Or dead.
: We’ll be fine either way. I know people. How do you think Rin gets her skulls?
: Call me if anything goes wrong or gets worse.
: Of course.
: She probably just needs to sleep it off. I’ll talk to her in the morning.
: And I won’t take no for an answer this time.
: Ooookay! Come on, junkie. Let’s get you into bed.
: Oh, you are? So I guess you just barged into my apartment because you changed your mind about hooking up with me then?
: You?
: Mhm. That’s what I thought.
: I’m gonna take your shoes off. Continue to be high if you consent!
: Got it. Jacket stays on. Just gonna check your arms first.
: Don’t......you.....fucking.....
: There! All done. I’d check your thighs too, but I don’t think we’re at that level yet and I’m sure you’ll be okay.
: Here. Water.
: Shh...
: Sleep now, okay?
: I’ll keep an eye on you for as long as I can...
Four hours, thirteen minutes, and eleven seconds.
That was how long Rika Rokuhara watched an addict that night.
It wasn’t her first time. Nor was it her second, third, fourth, or fifth.
Come to think of it, she didn’t know how many times she’d done something like this now.
It was sort of nostalgic in a way. But much worse than nostalgia normally is because there were no pleasant memories that clung to it in an effort to offset the bad ones.
When morning came, Yuki Yamaguchi awoke to an unfamiliar scent.
Strangely enough, however, this sort of unfamiliarity was familiar to her.
She’d also lost count of something — how many times she’s betrayed herself.
How many relapses, rebounds, and restarts she’d made over the course of a life that had tacked at least two or three decades onto her age.
It was catching up to her now, just not in the ways she expected.
And that was particularly strange to her, because she always expected the worst.
Who knew the worst would look like this?
: Where the...fuck?
She noticed something.
This something was strange too.
Someone had spent the night by her side. And this time, they didn’t have their way with her in the midst of her unconsciousness. Or at least she didn’t think she did.
Why was she here, though?
Zero hours, five minutes, and forty-three seconds.
That was how long Yuki Yamaguchi watched someone she didn’t know what to say to.
: I can feel you staring at me.
: Aren’t you going to say good morning?
: What am I doing here?
: More important question — how do you feel? You were zonked out of your mind when you busted in last night.
: Hah...fuck.
: Sorry to get you involved. I’ll fuck off back to my place now.
: No, stay.
: Let’s talk.
: I...appreciate the...gesture and shit...I ain’t really the talkin’ type, though.
: Hmm...
: What time is it right now?
: Think the alarm clock over there says...5:25, but I can’t really tell since there’s a...is that a fuckin’ rat in the way?
: That’s Frankenstein. He’s a good boy.
: Cool name...I guess...
: Yuki...Do you have any plans today, by any chance?
: Just...being a sack of shit. Same as always.
: Let’s go somewhere.
: What, like...together? I know you let me crash here last night, but I ain’t really got the cash right now if you want me to, like...buy you breakfast or-
: I’ll buy you breakfast.
: There’s somewhere else I want to go first, though.
: The gym?...
: Not a fan of working out? Need help learning how to use the machines?
: No, I...used to come here. Stopped, though.
: Free trial run out?
: Something like that, yeah.
: Well, I just so happen to come here every day. And I’m allowed to bring a guest, so...if you’re ever looking for something to do that doesn’t involve getting high, feel free to tag along.
: Man. You must really want to fuck me if you’re going to be my nurse and my personal trainer.
: You forgot about breakfast. My addict-coddling spree has only just begun.
: What are you doing, Yuki?
: Just...being a sack of shit. Same as always.
: How old are you? Thirties, right?
: Thirty-eight...
: Thirty-eight years old, and still running around like you’re invincible. Come on. We’ve gotta be more conscious about our bodies at this age. You know that, don’t you?
: You ain’t got the faintest fuckin’ idea.
: Then talk to me. Why are you doing this to yourself? To your daughter? Do you have any idea how she’d feel if she found out?
: Yumi? Like she’d give a shit about that. No one knows better than her that I ain’t nothin’ but a lost cause.
: There’s no such thing as a lost cause. Even the worst people in the world have a chance to make things right if they try.

: The fuck is right, though? The hell does that even mean? I ain’t hurtin’ anybody. Least not anymore. That ship’s already sailed. Then crashed into the goddamn dock and exploded into a million pieces.
: So find another ship.
: I did.
: I finally fucking did this time. And, you know...I really thought this was the one.
: I really thought I could just fuckin’...live my life after all these years. That all the horrible shit was behind me and I could become someone worthy.
: Of Yumi...Sara...everybody who keeps givin’ me a chance when I ain’t done shit to earn one. But of course that was all a fuckin’ dream. Of course it wouldn’t actually work like that.
: What happened then?
: The fuck do you think happened, Rika? Gimme your best fuckin’ guess, because you ain’t gonna get it.
: That’s why I’m asking. I know better than to ever expect an actual answer out of people like you. If you had one, things like this would never happen in the first place.
: Why even fucking ask then?
: Because it gets you talking. And talking makes you think. Talking makes you sad. Sadness is a spark.
: So what, you’re trying to fuckin’ set me on fire now? Think I’m gonna pull myself together out of pure sorrow? What’s the plan?
: To make you fucking miserable. That’s the plan.
: Well, you ain’t gotta work hard at all then. Mission complete.
: Oh, shut up. It’s not like I actually want you to be miserable. I just know that you need to hit rock bottom before you can find the strength to climb back up.
: I’m outta fuckin’ strength, Rika. I can’t do this shit anymore.
: Can I give you a little anecdote?
: Please. Anything to keep me from talkin’ about my fucking self.
: My daughter is adopted. My ex-partner and I both have vaginas, so we weren’t able to make a baby on our own.
: Great story. Have you sold the movie rights yet?
: Shush. I’m not done.
: Her biological mom had her when she was just a kid. Probably close to the same age my daughter is right now.
: She was fucked up beyond belief. Not from drugs, I don’t think. Just, like...trauma in general? Weird brain stuff? But she could barely even speak apparently.
: She was the definition of “rock bottom.” But even then...even though she was a fucking psycho, she managed to find the strength to do what was best for a baby and give her up to someone else.
: And if a deranged, psychotic, borderline-mute lady can find it in herself to put others first, I think a conscious, drug addict Yakuza lady can definitely do the same.
: So...is the moral there...what? How does that relate to me exactly?
: You know. Rock bottom. Good decisions. Do things for your daughter, not yourself.
: I guess it probably would have made more sense to talk about my dad being an addict too, huh?
: That probably would have been better, yeah...
: Point is, tons of other people out there have crawled out from the bottom of the barrel and turned their lives around. You could be the next one. You’ve just gotta wake the fuck up.
: Your daughter’s still your daughter, Yuki. She visits you. I’ve seen her outside. I’ve heard you guys watching wrestling through the walls. And I was only a little sad I wasn’t invited.
: Didn’t...realize you were into that sorta thing.
: Don’t do this to her. Or that Sara person I am now jealous of. Or any of the other people like Akira who love you.
: You still ain’t gettin’ it, Rika. I’ve heard this all before...and it ain’t changed shit.
: Have you ever heard from your cool onee-san, though? That changes everything, doesn’t it?
: Heh...no. I guess I haven’t.
: It doesn’t change anything, though.
: It’s too late, Rika.
: I can’t keep crawlin’ up from rock bottom.
: Maybe...if I were more like you.
: Maybe if I was actually there for my daughter when she was little, I might’ve changed sooner. Gone to the gym more. Stayed away from shit everybody knows is bad for you...but feels so fucking good.
: Now, though?...
: The hell am I supposed to do when I’m not with Yumi, huh? When I’m not working? Just sit around and fucking...be alone with myself? You have any idea what I think of when I’m alone, Rika?
: Do you have any idea how bad the temptation is to just fucking...ruin everything again so that something’s happening? So that I’m not just reaping the benefits of a life I haven’t earned?
: Combine those truths with the fact that the world just straight up doesn’t want people like me here and you get...
: Well...
: You get a fuckin’ death sentence.
: I want you here, Yuki.
: You barely know me.
: I barely knew my daughter at first too. Or my ex. Or all of my friends. But every one of them is extremely important to me now. And there’s no reason you can’t be too.
: Sorry, I...
: I just don’t...swing that way.
: This isn’t about that! I’m not going to hit on you just a couple hours after you woke up from a drug-addled episode of breaking and entering! I want to be your friend!
: Why, though?...I don’t get it.
: Because I-
: Because I’m selfish.
: You...wouldn’t get it.
: Right! Anyway! Let’s work out!
: Yeah. We stand around any longer, more people might start showin’ up and I won’t be able to talk about half of this shit anymore.
: We could always continue back at my place! Platonically, of course. Unless...
: Ugh...why do I feel like you’re about to become a huge pain in my ass all of a sudden?
: Probably because I am. I’ve never had a little sister before.
: And you don’t have one now. ‘Specially since I still see you as like, a...twenty-something.
: It’s all that time on the elliptical! Oh, here. I’ll show you how to use it. Just come over here and- Yuki?
: Sorry. I’m a punching bag only sorta girl. And I’ve got a lot of anger I need to get out right now.
Rika and Yuki have formed a bond!
Yay?
It’s noon again.
